sponsored.t: Exempts the East Herkimer Volunteer Fire Department No.1, Inc. from the requirement that the percentage of non-resident fire department members not exceed forty-five percent of the membership
sponsored.sum: Exempts the East Herkimer Volunteer Fire Department No. 1, Inc. from the requirement that the percentage of non-resident fire department members not exceed forty-five percent of the membership.

sponsored.t: Authorizes an occupancy tax in the county of Herkimer
sponsored.sum: Authorizes an occupancy tax in the county of Herkimer not to exceed 5%.

sponsored.t: Dedicates a portion of the state highway system to War Dogs
sponsored.sum: Dedicates a portion of the state highway system to War Dogs.
sponsored.fis: This legislation would effectively have no fiscal impact on state and local governments. The New York State Department of Transportation would be required to develop signage to mark the Highway.

sponsored.t: Dedicates a portion of the state highway system to Fort de la Presentation
sponsored.sum: Dedicates a portion of the state highway system constituting route 68 in the city of Ogdensburg, county of St. Lawrence, to Fort de la Presentation.

sponsored.t: Permits funds collected from the Oswego county occupancy tax to be used on making tourism related capital improvements
sponsored.sum: Permits funds collected from the Oswego county occupancy tax to be used on making tourism related capital improvements; removes such tax on permanent residents.

sponsored.t: Requires the county seat in Fulton county to have at least one polling place designated for early voting
sponsored.sum: Requires the county seat in Fulton county to have at least one polling place designated for early voting.

sponsored.t: Authorizing the county of Herkimer to impose hotel and motel taxes; and provides for the repeal of such provision upon the expiration thereof
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the county of Herkimer to impose hotel and motel taxes; provides for the repeal of such provision upon the expiration thereof.

sponsored.t: Permits the town of Redfield, Oswego county, to designate certain roads as minimum maintenance roads
sponsored.sum: Permits the town of Redfield, Oswego county, to designate certain roads as minimum maintenance roads.

sponsored.t: Relates to the deposit of additional sales and compensating use taxes by the county of Herkimer
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the deposit of additional sales and compensating use taxes by the county of Herkimer into the general fund of the county.

sponsored.t: Authorizes municipalities to require a permit for certain energy projects
sponsored.sum: Authorizes municipalities to require a permit for the construction of a major renewable energy facility, major electric transmission facility or certain major electric generating facilities.

sponsored.t: Dissolves the Clifton-Fine health care corporation; repealer
sponsored.sum: Dissolves the Clifton-Fine health care corporation and transfers any remaining records, property, rights, titles, and interest to the Clifton-Fine health care corporation d/b/a Clifton-Fine hospital, a New York not-for-profit corporation and its successors or assigns.

sponsored.t: Relates to the calculation of statewide greenhouse gas emission limits; repealer
sponsored.sum: Amends the definition of "carbon dioxide equivalent" to provide that such term be calculated based on a 100-year time frame after emission; provides for rules and regulations to amend the statewide greenhouse gas emissions limit; repeals provisions of law relating to statewide greenhouse gas emissions reductions.
sponsored.fis: New Yorkers will save hundreds of billions of dollars by repealing the emission mandates. The conservative cost estimate of compliance with the CLCPA is $340 billion.

sponsored.t: Establishes a municipal exemption from commercial driver's license requirements
sponsored.sum: Establishes a municipal exemption from commercial driver's license requirements when the vehicle utilized is owned or leased by a city, town, village, or county when such vehicle is operated by a municipal employee solely for intrastate governmental purposes.

sponsored.t: Relates to amending the constitution to prohibit an immediate vote to be called on budget bills
sponsored.sum: Amends the constitution to prohibit an immediate vote from being called by the governor or acting governor on any budget bills.

sponsored.t: Relates to capping the state budget at fifteen percent of total state gross domestic product
sponsored.sum: Relates to capping the state budget at fifteen percent of total state gross domestic product for the prior calendar year, as determined by the state comptroller.

sponsored.t: Relates to conveying land to the town of Montague, Lewis county, in order to allow the expansion of the town's barn for public use
sponsored.sum: Relates to conveying approximately 1.2 acres of land located within the forest preserve to the town of Montague, Lewis county, in order to allow the expansion of the town's barn for public use, in exchange for 26 acres of land to be conveyed by such town to the state.

sponsored.t: Proposes an amendment to section 7 of article 2 of the Constitution, in relation to requiring the use of paper ballots in elections
sponsored.sum: Proposes an amendment to require the use of paper ballots in elections.
sponsored.fis: May result in increased costs to accommodate for paper ballots.

sponsored.t: Enacts the "Learning for Work" act; appropriation
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "learning for work act"; establishes the youth apprenticeship program and the enhanced regents professional diploma; appropriates moneys therefor.

sponsored.t: Relates to crimes against public trust by state officers
sponsored.sum: Relates to crimes against public trust by state officers; requires such state officers' salary to be suspended pending indictment for such crimes; if convicted requires such state officers to pay back the portion of their salary beginning with the pay period immediately proceeding the date upon which the first convicted offense occurred.

sponsored.t: Relates to providing electronic toll collection devises for milk dealers free of charge
sponsored.sum: Provides milk dealers who operate trucks throughout the state buying, delivering, and selling milk with an EZ pass free of charge, where the authority will be responsible for the cost so long as it can be proved the truck is used exclusively for such purpose.

sponsored.t: Directs the office of mental health to develop materials relating to suicide prevention for school-aged children; authorizes school districts to include suicide prevention in health class curriculum
sponsored.sum: Directs the office of mental health to develop materials relating to suicide prevention and identifying signs of depression for school-aged children; authorizes school districts to include suicide prevention in health class curriculum.

sponsored.t: Establishes a pilot program authorizing certain nurse aides to administer medication in residential health care facilities in St. Lawrence county
sponsored.sum: Authorizes nursing home medication aides to administer medication in residential health care facilities in St. Lawrence county.

sponsored.t: Relates to implementing a shoreline hardening plan
sponsored.sum: Implements a shoreline hardening plan for all residents with property along Lake Ontario and the St. Lawrence river in order to prevent damage from flooding.

sponsored.t: Relates to redesigning the state flag
sponsored.sum: Authorizes and directs the commissioner of the office of general services to commission the flag design committee of the North American Vexillological Association to design a new state flag.

sponsored.t: Requires applicants for certain nursing licenses and certifications to complete training in the prevention of human trafficking
sponsored.sum: Requires applicants for certain nursing licenses and certifications to complete a course in the prevention of human trafficking; directs the commissioners of education and health to develop such training and regulations; directs that certain forfeited funds be used to reimburse actual costs expended for the development of such training.

sponsored.t: Relates to falsely reporting incidents in an attempt to bring about the dispatch of a large number of police officers to a particular address or location
sponsored.sum: Includes falsely reporting incidents in an attempt to bring about the dispatch of a large number of police officers to a particular address or location as a felony offense under the crime of falsely reporting an incident in the second degree.
sponsored.fis: None to the state. The bill is expected to save local resources by cutting down on the number of police responses to falsely reported inci- dents.

sponsored.t: Establishes the electronic open auction public bond sale pilot program for counties, cities, towns, villages and school districts
sponsored.sum: Establishes the electronic open auction public bond sale pilot program for counties, cities, towns, villages and school districts; provides such provisions shall remain in effect for 3 years.

sponsored.t: Allows any qualified person to apply for voter registration and enrollment by application made with an application for any hunting or fishing license
sponsored.sum: Allows any qualified person to apply for voter registration and enrollment by application made with an application for any hunting or fishing license.

sponsored.t: Relates to prohibited contributions by hostile foreign nations in connection with a state or local election
sponsored.sum: Prohibits contributions or donations to be made by hostile foreign nations in connection with a state or local election; makes a knowing violation of such provisions a class A felony, subject to an additional civil penalty equal to the contribution or donation amount plus a fine of up to ten thousand dollars.

sponsored.t: Removes certain provisions relating to preclearance by the civil rights bureau of certain policies relating to voting; repealer
sponsored.sum: Removes certain provisions relating to preclearance by the civil rights bureau of certain qualifications, prerequisites to voting, laws, ordinances, standards, practices, procedures, regulations, or policies relating to voting.

sponsored.t: Authorizes early voting sites to be placed at at least one city in a county, or if there is no city in such county, the county seat
sponsored.sum: Authorizes early voting sites to be placed at at least one city in a county, or if there is no city in such county, the county seat.

sponsored.t: Requires persons appointed as election commissioners to be citizens of the United States
sponsored.sum: Requires persons appointed as election commissioners to be citizens of the United States.

sponsored.t: Prohibits the state board of elections and local boards of elections from accepting donations of private funds for election administration
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the state board of elections and local boards of elections from accepting donations of private funds for election administration.

sponsored.t: Relates to the number of signatures for independent nominating petitions
sponsored.sum: Relates to the number of signatures for independent nominating petitions; decreases the number of signatures and votes to 15,000 signatures for statewide candidates and 50,000 votes to maintain party ballot status; changes the petition period to 12 weeks and the petitioning time to May-August.

sponsored.t: Removes the additional service charge for distinctive Elks Association license plates
sponsored.sum: Removes the additional $25 service charge for distinctive Elks Association license plates.

sponsored.t: Repeals certain provisions establishing a fee for background checks on certain firearm and ammunition purchases and amends the source of funds for the background check fund accordingly
sponsored.sum: Repeals certain provisions establishing a fee for background checks on certain firearm and ammunition purchases; removes such fees as a source of funds for the background check fund.
sponsored.fis: Loss in revenue with the straight repealer of said fees.

sponsored.t: Requires the county seat in Herkimer county to have at least one polling place designated for early voting
sponsored.sum: Requires the county seat in Herkimer county to have at least one polling place designated for early voting.

sponsored.t: Adds impersonation of board of elections members or other election officers to the crime of criminal impersonation in the first degree
sponsored.sum: Adds impersonation of board of elections members or other election officers, or an employee thereof, to the crime of criminal impersonation in the first degree.

sponsored.t: Creates the medical professionals across rural New York state student loan repayment fund pilot program
sponsored.sum: Relates to creating the medical professionals across rural New York state student loan repayment fund pilot program for certain participating professionals that make a two year commitment to practice in a tract or county defined by the health resources and services administration as being rural or eligible for a rural health grant.

sponsored.t: Bans unencapsulated expanded or extruded polystyrene foam in floating docks and floating platforms
sponsored.sum: Bans unencapsulated expanded or extruded polystyrene foam in floating docks and floating platforms sold, offered for sale, or constructed in the state.

sponsored.t: Includes land used for processing or retail merchandising of agricultural products within the real property tax exemption for land used in agricultural production
sponsored.sum: Includes land used for processing or retail merchandising of agricultural products within the real property tax exemption for land used in agricultural production.
sponsored.fis: None to the state. Since the bill only covers the value of new farm construction, there would be no negative impact on local revenues.

sponsored.t: Includes federal law enforcement officers in the definition of police officer
sponsored.sum: Includes federal law enforcement officers in the definition of police officer.

sponsored.t: Directs the commissioner of the division of homeland security and emergency services to conduct a study on the state's COVID-19 pandemic response
sponsored.sum: Directs the commissioner of the division of homeland security and emergency services to conduct an after-action review study on the state's COVID-19 pandemic response; directs the commissioner to submit a report on such study after 1 year and make such report publicly available on its website, and share such report with the CDC.
sponsored.fis: Minimal cost to pay for the study.

sponsored.t: Extends the registration period for trailers to 5 years
sponsored.sum: Extends the registration period for trailers, other than a coach or house trailer or a semitrailer, from 1 to 5 years; amends trailer registration fees to match the 5-year registration timeframe.
sponsored.fis: None, as trailer owners will pay five years' worth of registration fees upon registering their vehicles.

sponsored.t: Relates to certain farm wineries, farm breweries, farm distilleries, and farm cideries whose business includes agricultural tourism
sponsored.sum: Relates to certain farm wineries, farm breweries, farm distilleries, and farm cideries whose business includes agricultural tourism.

sponsored.t: Requires state agencies to expend funds no later than ninety days after receipt of a certificate of approval from the director of the budget
sponsored.sum: Requires state agencies to expend funds no later than ninety days after receipt of a certificate of approval from the director of the budget; reduces the budget of an agency that violates such requirement for the upcoming fiscal year by 1% of the amount of the late award.

sponsored.t: Requires a valid government issued photo identification card to be presented when casting a ballot
sponsored.sum: Requires a New York state driver's license or non-driver ID, a United States passport, an identification card issued by a United States educational institution, a United States military identification card, a government issued medical card, or any identification card issued by the United States or the state of New York to be presented when casting a ballot.

sponsored.t: Requires solar facilities to conspicuously post safety data sheets in areas that may be accessed by emergency responders in the case of a fire or other emergency
sponsored.sum: Requires solar facilities to conspicuously post safety data sheets in areas that may be accessed by emergency responders in the case of a fire or other emergency.

sponsored.t: Establishes minimum maintenance roads in the town of Montague, Lewis county
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the town of Montague in Lewis county to designate certain town roads as low-volume roads and certain low-volume roads as minimum maintenance roads.
sponsored.fis: : Savings for town of Montague taxpayers.

sponsored.t: Creates distinctive license plates for the United States army 10th mountain division
sponsored.sum: Creates distinctive license plates for members and supporters of the United States army 10th mountain division.

sponsored.t: Creates a series of distinctive license plates for law enforcement officers who were wounded in the line of duty
sponsored.sum: Creates a series of distinctive license plates for law enforcement officers who were wounded in the line of duty or the spouse of such, which shall bear the words "Wounded in the Line of Duty"; includes the New York state sheriff's association, New York state association of chiefs of police, police benevolent association of the New York state troopers, the New York state police benevolent association, and the New York city police benevolent association; provides that proceeds from the service charge shall be used for a fund to assist wounded/fallen officers and their families.

sponsored.t: Allows certain firearm licensees to open carry
sponsored.sum: Expands the firearm license to have and carry concealed, without regard to employment or place of possession, to include open carry.

sponsored.t: Relates to creating the crime of attempt to engage in sexual conduct with a person incapable of consent
sponsored.sum: Relates to creating the crime of attempt to engage in sexual conduct with a person incapable of consent when an individual communicates such individual's intent to engage in sexual conduct with the victim, and engages in certain acts which would tend to further effect the commission of such sexual conduct; designates such attempt as a class C felony, class E felony, or class A misdemeanor; designates individuals convicted of such crime as sex offenders.

sponsored.t: Dissolves the New York state thruway authority, and transferring all functions, duties, debts, and obligations of such authority to the department of transportation; repealer
sponsored.sum: Dissolves the New York state thruway authority; transfers all functions, employees, records, authority, debts and obligations of such authority to the department of transportation.
sponsored.fis: Savings due to consolidation of the Thruway Authority and the Department of Transportation.

sponsored.t: Relates to verification of voter qualifications
sponsored.sum: Requires the state board of elections to participate in the systematic alien verification for entitlements (SAVE) program, administered by the United States citizenship and immigration services agency, to verify that a person who is either registered or registering to vote is a United States citizen.

sponsored.t: Relates to the removal of weight and height restrictions on vehicles traveling from the Ogdensburg bridge south to the Port of Ogdensburg
sponsored.sum: Removes the weight and height restrictions on vehicles traveling south on the route from the Ogdensburg bridge to the Port of Ogdensburg.

sponsored.t: Enacts the geothermal education and outreach (GEO) act
sponsored.sum: Directs NYSERDA to develop a geothermal education and outreach program to provide guidelines, planning, and financial support for qualified school districts that wish to convert to a geothermal energy system as their primary source of energy.

sponsored.t: Grants David Morse, the parent of firefighter Peyton Morse, accidental death benefits
sponsored.sum: Grants David Morse, the parent of firefighter Peyton Morse, who was employed by the city of Watertown, accidental death benefits.

sponsored.t: Creates the New York state commission on government efficiency
sponsored.sum: Creates the New York state commission on government efficiency to examine state spending, identify unnecessary and wasteful spending and create a report of recommendations of spending items that can be eliminated by New York state.

sponsored.t: Requires the use of canines for contraband screening at correctional facilities housing one hundred or more incarcerated individuals
sponsored.sum: Requires the use of canines for contraband screening at correctional facilities housing one hundred or more incarcerated individuals.

sponsored.t: Relates to the identification of correction officers
sponsored.sum: Requires that correction officers employed in correctional facilities be identified by badge number only.

sponsored.t: Authorizes school districts to establish reserve funds for special services or programs
sponsored.sum: Authorizes school districts to establish reserve funds for special services or programs upon approval by the board of education of such district in an amount not to exceed 10% of other reserve funds of the district.

sponsored.t: Relates to healthy school meals
sponsored.sum: Relates to purchases of food products for school meals from New York state farmers, growers, producers or processors; prohibits sale of school foods containing certain synthetic color additives; establishes a "healthy kitchens, healthy schools program" to provide grants for kitchen upgrades; prohibits school meals from containing more than 25 grams of added sugars per day, in aggregate.
sponsored.fis: Possible increase in state spending for grant program.

sponsored.t: Increases the applicable percentage of the child tax credit allowed in the empire state child tax credit to forty-five percent
sponsored.sum: Increases the applicable percentage of the child tax credit allowed in the empire state child tax credit from thirty-three percent to forty-five percent; prescribes how such payment or refund should be made based on amount.
sponsored.fis: Approximately $299 million in additional State spending.

sponsored.t: Increases the earned income tax credit
sponsored.sum: Increases the earned income tax credit for taxable years beginning in 2025.
sponsored.fis: Approximately $386 million in loss of tax revenue.

sponsored.t: Prohibits the imposition of a system benefits charge on ratepayers' utility bills
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the public service commission's imposition of a system benefits charge on ratepayers' utility bills.
sponsored.fis: Approximately $100 million loss in revenue for New York State.

sponsored.t: Relates to expanding criminal mischief in the third degree to include damaging property of another as an expression of political ideology
sponsored.sum: Provides that a person is guilty of criminal mischief in the third degree when such person intentionally damages property of another person to promote or suppress a political ideology, or otherwise as an expression of political ideology.

sponsored.t: Relates to competitive grants for water quality infrastructure projects
sponsored.sum: Requires no less than two percent of all state competitive grants for water quality infrastructure projects to be awarded to municipalities located in the Adirondack park and Catskill park.

sponsored.t: Requires a percentage of profits to be paid to a taxing jurisdiction or land owner under certain agreements for the installation and use of solar or wind energy equipment
sponsored.sum: Requires 12.5% of profits generated from a solar or wind energy system to be paid to a taxing jurisdiction or land owner under certain agreements for the installation and use of such solar or wind energy system, in addition to other PILOT or other payments required under such agreement.
sponsored.fis: Undetermined, but would likely increase local government income.

sponsored.t: Excludes certain solar or wind energy projects in the county of Lewis from certain appraisal models and discount rates
sponsored.sum: Excludes solar or wind energy projects in the county of Lewis that were already in existence on the effective date of Part N of chapter 59 of the laws of 2023 from certain appraisal models and discount rates.
sponsored.fis: Potential revenue increase for local municipalities if Part N does in fact apply to all projects in New York.

sponsored.t: Relates to flood insurance notice in communities bordering Lake Ontario
sponsored.sum: Relates to flood insurance notice in communities bordering Lake Ontario; requires the department of financial services to publish an annual notice with the department's contact information and a statement about flood insurance and how it relates to standard homeowners insurance policies in local newspapers that serve the communities bordering Lake Ontario.

sponsored.t: Provides for temporary exemptions to educational institutions from certain requirements related to the multi-occupancy bathrooms and locker rooms; and authorizes funding for related improvements
sponsored.sum: Provides for temporary exemptions to educational institutions from certain requirements related to the use of multi-occupancy bathrooms and locker rooms; authorizes the use of state building aid for related facility improvements.

sponsored.t: Relates to authorizing the town of Dekalb, in the county of St. Lawrence, to reduce the maximum speed limit on certain public roadways
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the town of Dekalb, in the county of St. Lawrence, to reduce the maximum speed limit on a portion of United States route eleven.
sponsored.fis: None to the state. This legislation may have a positive fiscal impact on the locality by reducing the number of traffic incidents on its roads.

sponsored.t: Authorizes Matthew Terpening to take the competitive civil service examination for the position of police officer for employment as a full-time police officer for the town of Webb, county of Herkimer
sponsored.sum: Authorizes Matthew Terpening to take the competitive civil service examination for the position of police officer and be placed on the eligible list for employment as a full-time police officer for the town of Webb, county of Herkimer.

sponsored.t: Reestablishes the office of coroner in the county of Oswego and removing the powers and duties of coroners from the district attorney in such county and allows Oswego County to appoint a coroner
sponsored.sum: Reestablishes the office of coroner in the county of Oswego; removes the powers and duties of coroners from the district attorney in such county; allows Oswego County to appoint a coroner.

sponsored.t: Requires a fiscal note when a bill enacts or amends a law impacting the cost of utility services
sponsored.sum: Requires a fiscal note when a bill enacts or amends a law impacting the cost of utility services.

sponsored.t: Increases the reimbursement amount authorized to be paid to localities maintaining incarcerated individuals convicted of felonies
sponsored.sum: Increases the reimbursement amount authorized to be paid to localities maintaining incarcerated individuals convicted of felonies to $300 per day per capita for the first 10 days, and $600 per day per capita for each day thereafter, or the actual per day per capita cost, whichever is more.
sponsored.fis: Increased cost to New York State for reimbursement, which currently falls on counties. Therefore, New York State could see a cost increase in excess of $200 million per year. On a similar note, counties would see a cost savings of over $200 million per year.

sponsored.t: Requires e-commerce platforms to include a feature whereby consumers may filter for products made in the United States of America; and provides a tax credit for compliance or sale of certain products
sponsored.sum: Requires e-commerce platforms to include a feature whereby consumers may filter for products made in the United States of America; provides for a tax credit for online marketplace providers or online retailers who include such filter, or who sell products made in New York state, in the amount of state sales taxes for such products.

sponsored.t: Extends authorization for the county of Lewis to impose an additional one percent of sales and compensating use taxes
sponsored.sum: Extends authorization for the county of Lewis to impose an additional one percent of sales and compensating use taxes until November 30, 2027.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the county of Jefferson to impose additional sales tax
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the county of Jefferson to impose additional sales tax until November 30th, 2027.

sponsored.t: Extends authorization for the county of Fulton to impose an additional one percent of sales and compensating use taxes
sponsored.sum: Extends authorization for the county of Fulton to impose an additional one percent of sales and compensating use taxes until November 30, 2027.

sponsored.t: Extends provisions allowing the county of Fulton to impose a mortgage recording tax
sponsored.sum: Extends provisions allowing the county of Fulton to impose a county recording tax on obligation secured by a mortgage on real property to November 30, 2027.

sponsored.t: Extends the authorization of the county of Hamilton to impose an additional one percent of sales and compensating use taxes
sponsored.sum: Extends the authorization of the county of Hamilton to impose an additional one percent of sales and compensating use taxes to November 30, 2027.

sponsored.t: Extends certain provisions authorizing the county of Hamilton to impose a county recording tax on obligations secured by mortgages on real property
sponsored.sum: Extends certain provisions authorizing the county of Hamilton to impose a county recording tax on obligations secured by mortgages on real property to December 1, 2027.

sponsored.t: Extends the authorization of the county of Oswego to impose an additional rate of sales taxes.
sponsored.sum: Extends the authorization of the county of Oswego to impose an additional one percent of sales and compensating use taxes.

sponsored.t: Enacts the "city of Little Falls deficit financing act" authorizing the city of Little Falls, in the county of Herkimer, to finance certain deficits by the issuance of bonds
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the city of Little Falls, in the county of Herkimer, to issue serial bonds in an aggregate principal amount not to exceed three million four hundred thousand dollars for the purpose of liquidating deficits in its general, golf, and water funds; requires that the city of Little Falls prepare quarterly budget reports, quarterly trial balances and a three-year financial plan.
sponsored.fis: None to the state; $3.4 million in bonds for the city of Little Falls.

sponsored.t: Extends the period during which the county of Herkimer is authorized to impose additional sales and compensating use taxes
sponsored.sum: Extends the period during which the county of Herkimer is authorized to impose additional sales and compensating use taxes to November 30, 2027.

sponsored.t: Extends authorization of the county of Herkimer to impose a county recording tax on obligation secured by a mortgage on real property
sponsored.sum: Extends authorization of the county of Herkimer to impose a county recording tax on obligation secured by a mortgage on real property to 12/01/2027.
